stemMarkdown: Two trains, 185 m and 275 m long, are running towards each other on parallel tracks at 63 km/h and 69 km/h. How many seconds do they take to cross each other completely? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Opposite directions means the speeds add: $63 + 69 = 132$ km/h $= 36.6667$ m/s. They must cover the sum of their lengths, $185 + 275 = 460$ m, so the time is $\dfrac{460}{36.6667} = 12.5455$ seconds.
